name: image-tile
title: Image tile
description: A picture tile with its title on the image, for a category, a destination or a collection: one link, a scrim that keeps the text readable on any photo.
docs: The whole tile is one link (href). Give every tile of a grid the same ratio and the rows stay level. align='start' puts the text at the bottom left with the arrow at the right; align='center' centres it over a dim that is deepest behind the text. The text is always white on a scrim, so it reads on any photo in light and dark. Hover pulls the picture in and nudges the arrow, both off under reduced motion; the focus ring is drawn inside the tile. Titles clamp to two lines, and below about 13rem wide the arrow moves to the corner. alt is empty by default because the title names the link. priority loads a tile above the fold at once.
